title: Failed Payment / Amount Deducted
description: If the payment gateway confirms a successful debit but the order was not created locally, the customer is eligible for a reconciliation refund.

title: Refund Pending
description: An initiated refund that is still in pending status is being processed and awaiting bank settlement.

title: Return & Exchange
description: Products can be returned within 10 days of delivery if unused and undamaged.

title: Return Received — Refund Eligibility
description: If a returned item has been received at the warehouse, the customer is fully eligible for a refund.

title: Order Cancellation
description: Customers may request confirmation of cancellation status and reason for any order marked cancelled in the system.

title: Damaged Product Claim
description: Physical damage claims require photo verification from the customer before a replacement or refund is issued.

title: Duplicate Payment Refund
description: Customers are eligible for a full refund if a duplicate payment is detected within 7 days of transaction.

title: Wrong Product Delivered
description: If a customer receives an item different from what was ordered, warehouse dispatch logs must be compared before a refund or replacement is issued.

title: Account Security Review
description: Any suspected unauthorized account access must be escalated to the security team for manual review before any account or payment action is taken.

title: Delivered Not Received
description: If tracking shows delivery but the customer disputes receipt, courier proof-of-delivery must be obtained before resolution.

title: Delayed Delivery / In-Transit
description: If an order remains in_transit beyond its expected delivery window, the customer is eligible for a shipping credit or expedited redelivery.
